active_problem: The existing selected-quarterback drilldown is an older shallow analysis view and does not provide the professional Page 2 command center requested by the user. The normalized slate also exposes only the recent five individual game rows, making Last 10/Season/Home-Away hit-rate views incomplete even though verified current-season NFLverse rows are already loaded upstream.
solution: Keep Page 1 unchanged. Route only the selected-QB detail handoff into a new Page 2 renderer that consumes normalized Kyre Sports API data. Add a successor slate overlay that enriches the selected-player detail with the exact current-season game log from already-loaded NFLverse rows using source player ID + team matching. Render verified values or explicit unavailable states, keep sportsbook observations independent, and never synthesize missing values.
